physical_data_entities.name: Organisation
physical_data_entities.description: A client organisation that owns requests, assets, and conversations and defines the tenant boundary.

physical_data_entities.name: User
physical_data_entities.description: A person who can log into the portal and interact with organisations, requests, and assets.

physical_data_entities.name: Role
physical_data_entities.description: A named role that defines what actions a user is allowed to perform in the system.

physical_data_entities.name: UserRole
physical_data_entities.description: A link between a user and a role indicating which roles the user has.

physical_data_entities.name: OrganisationUser
physical_data_entities.description: A link between a user and an organisation representing membership in that organisation.

physical_data_entities.name: ProducerAssignment
physical_data_entities.description: A record that assigns a Rivvy Producer to a client organisation for delivery responsibility.

physical_data_entities.name: Request
physical_data_entities.description: A creative work request submitted by a client organisation for asset creation.

physical_data_entities.name: Asset
physical_data_entities.description: A delivered video or image asset with metadata and a reference to stored media.

physical_data_entities.name: CommentThread
physical_data_entities.description: A conversation container associated with an asset for feedback and discussion.

physical_data_entities.name: Comment
physical_data_entities.description: A single message within a comment thread created by a user.

physical_data_attributes.name: id
physical_data_attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organisation.

physical_data_attributes.name: name
